stories.title: ICRA sees PV sales up 4 to 6% in FY27 after a 28% H1 surge
stories.summary: ICRA expects India's passenger vehicle wholesales to rise about 4% to 6% in FY27 after a roughly 28% surge in the first half, helped by GST cuts, replacement demand and new models. Inventory has climbed toward 45 days ahead of the festive push.

stories.title: Maruti EV exports cross 50,000 while domestic EV sales stay thin
stories.summary: Maruti Suzuki says cumulative EV exports have crossed 50,000 units, while domestic EV sales remain below 12,000. The export push is doing the heavy lifting that the home market has not yet matched.

stories.title: Hyundai Motor India shares jump after record Q2 sales print
stories.summary: Hyundai Motor India shares rose more than 5% after the company reported record quarterly sales in Q2 FY27, even as profit margins stayed under watch. Brokerages looked through the margin noise to the volume print.

stories.title: India car export growth slows on West Asia war and a high base
stories.summary: Moneycontrol reports India's car export growth has slowed as the West Asia conflict and a higher base weigh on shipments. Overseas volumes that looked easy a year ago now need a clearer route map.

stories.title: Hyundai and Maruti post record Q2 sales while margins tighten
stories.summary: The Financial Express sets out five factors behind contracting margins at Hyundai and Maruti Suzuki even as both logged record Q2 sales. Volume records and margin slides can share the same quarter.

stories.title: Hyundai says eight in ten India cars could be SUVs by 2030
stories.summary: Cartoq cites Hyundai's outlook that about eight out of ten cars it sells in India may be SUVs by 2030. The hatchback aisle is not getting the product planners' best stationery.

stories.title: Maruti says EV exports crossed 50,000 since August 2025
stories.summary: Business Standard reports Maruti Suzuki India's cumulative electric vehicle exports have crossed 50,000 units since August 2025. The Gujarat export hub is carrying the EV story more than the domestic order book.

stories.title: Rajendra Petkar signs off after 38 years as Tata Motors CTO
stories.summary: Autocar Professional marks Rajendra Petkar's exit as president and CTO of Tata Motors after a 38-year engineering run that began as a TELCO trainee. The product pipeline he leaves is the real handover note.

stories.title: Tata Sierra ICE AWD timeline firms up, CNG may join later
stories.summary: CarLelo reports Tata's Sierra ICE all-wheel-drive launch timeline, with CNG discussed as a later range option. The brochure still has blank pages where the fuel badges go. Tata Sierra ICE AWD timeline firms up, CNG may join later

stories.title: Tata Altroz crosses 3.5 lakh sales in India
stories.summary: Autocar India says the Tata Altroz has crossed 3.5 lakh cumulative sales in India. The premium hatch keeps filling order books without needing a new segment name every quarter. Tata Altroz crosses 3.5 lakh sales in India

stories.title: Volkswagen Taigun crosses 1 lakh sales, VW's top India SUV
stories.summary: Cartoq reports the Volkswagen Taigun has crossed 1 lakh sales in India and is the brand's highest-selling SUV here. The waiting list finally has a round number to celebrate. Volkswagen Taigun crosses 1 lakh sales, VW's top India SUV

stories.title: MINI Cooper SE and Paul Smith edition set for 27 November India launch
stories.summary: Coverage confirms the MINI Cooper SE and a Paul Smith edition are slated for India launch on 27 November 2026. The electric Mini arrives with a designer collaboration and a date that dealers can actually put on a banner.

stories.title: Five new sub-4-metre SUVs due in six months, from Mahindra to Hyundai
stories.summary: Cartoq lists five new sub-4-metre SUVs expected within six months, spanning Mahindra's Vision S to Hyundai's Ioniq P. The length limit still decides who fits in the basement parking. Five new sub-4-metre SUVs due in six months, from Mahindra to Hyundai

stories.title: Maserati brings GranTurismo, GranCabrio and Grecale facelifts to India
stories.summary: Autocar Professional reports Maserati has launched facelifted Granturismo, Grancabrio and Grecale models in India. The trident's price tags still start well above the average housing down payment. Maserati brings GranTurismo, GranCabrio and Grecale facelifts to India

stories.title: Hyundai's sub-4m electric SUV may be called Ioniq P for 2027
stories.summary: Livemint reports Hyundai's new sub-4-metre electric SUV could be badged Ioniq P, with a launch expected in 2027. The name race is running ahead of the showroom date. Hyundai's sub-4m electric SUV may be called Ioniq P for 2027

stories.title: VinFast VF5 design patent hints at another electric SUV for India
stories.summary: CarDekho covers a VinFast VF5 design patent that hints at a new electric SUV aimed at India. Patent drawings are not a launch, but they are a clearer signal than a teaser sketch.

stories.title: Hyundai Ioniq P tipped as the compact EV for India
stories.summary: GaadiWaale reports Hyundai's compact electric SUV, earlier coded HE1i, is likely to be named Ioniq P and will compete in India's small EV SUV pack. The badge is doing warm-up laps before the unveil.

stories.title: Tata Punch launches in South Africa with a 120 hp turbo petrol
stories.summary: Autocar India reports the Tata Punch has launched in South Africa with a 120 hp turbo-petrol engine. The compact SUV that owns Indian parking lots is now collecting foreign number plates.

stories.title: Hero Vida crosses 2 lakh electric scooter sales in 2026
stories.summary: Autocar India says Vida sold about 2,00,143 electric scooters from 1 January to 29 October 2026, against 1,13,021 in all of 2025. October helped push the calendar-year tally past two lakh for the first time.

stories.title: TVS electric two-wheeler sales jump 133% in Q2
stories.summary: Trade Brains reports TVS Motor's electric two-wheeler sales surged about 133% in Q2, raising the question of how far EVs can pull FY27 growth. The scooter aisle is where the percentage signs look tallest.

stories.title: Bajaj Auto to add two new lines in the 125-250 cc band
stories.summary: Autocar India reports Bajaj Auto plans two new product lines in the 125-250 cc segment. The middleweight shelf is getting fresh nameplates rather than another sticker pack. Bajaj Auto to add two new lines in the 125-250 cc band

stories.title: Bajaj aims for 80,000 Chetak units a month by Q4 FY27
stories.summary: Autocar India says Bajaj plans to raise Chetak production to about 80,000 units a month by the fourth quarter of FY2027. Electric scooter capacity is becoming a monthly number war.

stories.title: TVS targets 80,000 e-two-wheelers a month as EVs top 20% of scooters
stories.summary: The Economic Times reports TVS Motor aims to make about 80,000 electric two-wheelers a month as EVs capture more than 20% of India's scooter market. The plug-in share is no longer a footnote.

stories.title: Hero readies new Karizma and Xpulse models for launch
stories.summary: Autocar India reports new Hero Karizma and Xpulse models are being readied for launch. The adventure and performance badges get another turn in the spotlight before the festive dust settles.

stories.title: H1 FY27 motorcycle exports: Boxer to Xtreme fill the ship holds
stories.summary: RushLane rounds up H1 FY2027 motorcycle export tallies across Boxer, Star City, Pulsar, CT, FZ, Apache, Gixxer, Raider and Xtreme. The crates leaving the docks still speak fluent commuter and sport.

stories.title: eNEG works on a Rs 4.5 lakh electric taxi with battery subscription
stories.summary: Autocar India reports eNEG Mobility is developing an electric taxi priced around Rs 4.5 lakh with a battery subscription model. The meter still runs. The battery bill arrives separately. eNEG works on a Rs 4.5 lakh electric taxi with battery subscription

stories.title: AVAS hum becomes mandatory on new electric cars in India
stories.summary: Carandbike explains that Acoustic Vehicle Alerting System rules require new electric cars in India to emit a sound at low speeds from October 2026. Silent EVs now have a regulated hum for pedestrians.

stories.title: BMW says Tesla's India entry will grow the EV market, not scare it
stories.summary: ET Government quotes BMW saying Tesla's entry will help grow India's EV market and that the brand is not worried about competition. Another premium badge on the charging queue is framed as demand creation.

stories.title: Blue Energy Motors and HPCL open Bhiwandi's first e-truck battery swap station
stories.summary: Entrepreneur India reports Blue Energy Motors inaugurated Bhiwandi's first electric heavy-duty truck battery-swap station with HPCL. Long-haul electric trucks need a swap stop before they need a speech. Blue Energy Motors and HPCL open Bhiwandi's first e-truck battery swap station

stories.title: Tata Safari EV may pack up to an 80 kWh battery
stories.summary: CarLelo reports the Tata Safari EV could get a battery pack of up to about 80 kWh. Range claims will still meet the Western Ghats and the air conditioner in summer.

stories.title: VinFast sketches India plans across EVs, free charging and e-two-wheelers
stories.summary: Auto India Daily outlines VinFast's India strategy spanning electric cars, free charging pitches and electric two-wheelers. The Vietnamese brand is laying out a full aisle, not a single showroom hero.

stories.title: EV charging is turning into its own investment story in India
stories.summary: Business News This Week frames India's EV charging business as a fresh investment opportunity beside the vehicles themselves. The plug is becoming a balance-sheet line, not only a parking bay feature.

stories.title: EKA Mobility opens six plants, capacity beyond 40,000 EVs
stories.summary: CNBC-TV18 reports EKA Mobility and group companies have opened six manufacturing facilities, taking capacity beyond 40,000 EVs under a multi-thousand-crore investment plan across Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra. EKA Mobility opens six plants, capacity beyond 40,000 EVs

stories.title: Tata Motors takes 89.42% of Iveco in €3.43 billion CV deal
stories.summary: The Economic Times reports Tata Motors has taken an 89.42% stake in Italian commercial vehicle maker Iveco for about €3.43 billion, gaining control of the European CV specialist. The truck aisle just got a much longer map.

stories.title: Jefferies: truck registrations up about 34%, CVs lead October growth
stories.summary: Coverage citing Jefferies says India's commercial vehicle segment is expected to lead October auto sales, with truck registrations up around 34% as festive timing weighs on cars and two-wheelers. Jefferies: truck registrations up about 34%, CVs lead October growth

stories.title: M. R. Shah Group puts Blue Energy Motors LNG trucks on long-haul routes
stories.summary: India Shipping News reports the M. R. Shah Group is deploying Blue Energy Motors LNG trucks for long-haul freight. Gas-fuelled trucks are leaving the pilot slide and joining the night highway.

stories.title: Montra Electric partners with VFRYT on electric commercial vehicles
stories.summary: Motown India reports Montra Electric has partnered with VFRYT for electric commercial vehicles. Another CV badge joins the electric fleet pitch with a supplier handshake attached. Montra Electric partners with VFRYT on electric commercial vehicles

stories.title: BikeWo and Green Drive Mobility target 5,000 electric trucks
stories.summary: Indian Transport and Logistics reports BikeWo and Green Drive Mobility are targeting a fleet of about 5,000 electric trucks. The number is large enough to need charging plans, not only press notes.

stories.title: Tractor demand heads for a likely three-year low on arid farms
stories.summary: The Economic Times reports tractor sales may fall by up to about 10% year on year toward a three-year low as arid conditions hit farms, while some dealers also see weaker entry-level car and two-wheeler demand.

stories.title: Motherson Sumi Q2 profit up 35% to Rs 223 crore on auto-part demand
stories.summary: Moneycontrol reports Motherson Sumi Wiring's net profit rose about 35% to Rs 223 crore in the quarter on stronger auto-part demand. Wiring harnesses still track the vehicle lines that keep them busy.

stories.title: Michelin launches X Multi Energy Z2 as its most fuel-efficient India tyre
stories.summary: Motown India reports Michelin has launched the X Multi Energy Z2, pitched as its most fuel-efficient tyre for India truck and bus fleets. Fleet managers will measure the claim in litres, not brochures.

stories.title: Gulf Oil Lubricants India Q2 profit rises 34% to Rs 117 crore
stories.summary: BW Auto World reports Gulf Oil Lubricants India's second-quarter profit rose about 34% to Rs 117 crore. The oil aisle still reports even when the headlines prefer batteries. Gulf Oil Lubricants India Q2 profit rises 34% to Rs 117 crore

stories.title: Endurance maps a more technology-driven aftermarket for EVs and beyond
stories.summary: Motown India carries Endurance's roadmap for a more technology-driven aftermarket spanning conventional parts and EV needs. The spares counter is learning software words between the gasket drawers. Endurance maps a more technology-driven aftermarket for EVs and beyond

stories.title: Gulf Oil marks 125 years and pushes a fresh India growth plan
stories.summary: Motorindia reports Gulf Oil is celebrating 125 years while accelerating India growth and expansion plans. The anniversary cake shares the table with a volume target. Gulf Oil marks 125 years and pushes a fresh India growth plan

stories.title: Goa buyer wins Rs 6.30 lakh after dealer refuses sports car booking refund
stories.summary: The Indian Express reports a Goa man won a Rs 6.30 lakh payout after a sports car booking was cancelled and the dealer refused a refund. Consumer forums still read booking receipts carefully.

stories.title: Renault to prioritise dealer profitability over network expansion in India
stories.summary: The Financial Express reports Renault will prioritise dealer profitability over expanding its India network. Fewer new boards, healthier existing ones, is the current retail math. Renault to prioritise dealer profitability over network expansion in India

stories.title: Dealers chase dead stock that quietly kills cash flow
stories.summary: Motorindia walks through how dead stock in auto dealerships becomes a cash-flow killer and what retail teams can do about it. The parts room has a way of filling itself without asking.

stories.title: Greaves Cotton Q2 revenue up 44% to Rs 1,176 crore, EBITDA up 43%
stories.summary: BW Auto World reports Greaves Cotton's consolidated Q2 revenue rose about 44% to Rs 1,176 crore with EBITDA up about 43%, even as EV losses remain a watched line. Engines and electric bets share the same results slide.

stories.title: Tata Motors takes control of Iveco, focus shifts to debt and integration
stories.summary: Coverage says Tata Motors took control of Iveco in a €3.43 billion deal, with attention now on debt and integration. Buying the truck maker was step one. Making the spreadsheet settle is step two.

stories.title: Chip shortage may delay auto meter fare revision by a month
stories.summary: The New Indian Express reports a chip shortage may delay revision of auto-rickshaw meters by about a month. Fare apps can update overnight. The physical meter still waits on a semiconductor.

stories.title: South Korea leads SAE J3016 revision clarifying six autonomous levels
stories.summary: Reports say South Korean researchers are leading a revision of the SAE J3016 autonomous driving standard that clarifies the six-level criteria. The ladder from driver aids to full autonomy gets another footnote.

stories.title: Semiconductors keep showing up as the bottleneck in software-defined cars
stories.summary: Design News argues semiconductors are what actually enable software-defined vehicles, tying chip supply to the features carmakers put on slides. The SDV deck still ends with a silicon procurement line.

stories.title: Supreme Court asks the government about fuel supply for 100% ethanol vehicles
stories.summary: ET Auto reports India's push for 100% ethanol-run vehicles faces a Supreme Court question to the government over fuel supply. The vehicle mandate is only as real as the pump that serves it.

stories.title: Heavy Industries minister urges investment in EV batteries and hydrogen
stories.summary: ET Auto reports minister H. D. Kumaraswamy urging the auto industry to invest in EV technologies, batteries and hydrogen. The speech list matches the factory list the industry already argues about.

stories.title: Gadkari proposes 20% speeding leeway on expressways
stories.summary: Autocar India reports Nitin Gadkari has proposed about 20% leeway for speeding on expressways. Highway patrol WhatsApp groups will have opinions before the rulebook does. Gadkari proposes 20% speeding leeway on expressways

stories.title: EU Circular Vehicle Regulation webinar flags recycler challenges
stories.summary: Auto Recycling World covers an IRT webinar on the EU Circular Vehicle Regulation and the challenges facing automotive recyclers. End-of-life rules are becoming a product design input, not only a scrapyard problem.

stories.title: Ducati joins the Indian Supercross Racing League
stories.summary: Autocar India reports Ducati has joined the Indian Supercross Racing League. Another premium motorcycle badge is now on the dirt-track entry list, beside the local race calendar that dealers already watch.

stories.title: Navi Mumbai readies December Formula 4 race, civic body eyes Rs 40 crore
stories.summary: The Free Press Journal reports Navi Mumbai is gearing up for a December Formula 4 race, with the civic body projecting about Rs 40 crore revenue over four years. Local motorsport gets a calendar date and a spreadsheet.

stories.title: F1 return to India by 2028 stays a live question, not a contract
stories.summary: Mashable India revisits why Formula 1 left India and what could bring it back by around 2028. The rumour mill is warmer than the circuit paperwork. F1 return to India by 2028 stays a live question, not a contract

stories.title: Indian Auto LPG Coalition urges states to adopt clean mobility models
stories.summary: Manufacturing Today India reports the Indian Auto LPG Coalition urging states to adopt clean mobility models. Autogas wants a seat beside the EV slides in state policy rooms. Indian Auto LPG Coalition urges states to adopt clean mobility models

stories.title: India flags progress on its first hydrogen-powered train
stories.summary: A PIB release covers India's first hydrogen-powered train as part of green rail mobility plans. Clean mobility headlines still include tracks, not only charging plazas. India flags progress on its first hydrogen-powered train

stories.title: Electric cars outsell petrol cars in the EU for the first time
stories.summary: Electrifying.com reports electric cars outsold petrol cars in the EU for the first time. The continental mix tip is the chart European dealers have been waiting to screenshot. Electric cars outsell petrol cars in the EU for the first time

stories.title: Global light-vehicle sales seen down 3.7% as Europe grows and China sinks
stories.summary: Automotive World says global light-vehicle sales are set to fall about 3.7%, with Europe growing while China sinks. The world chart no longer moves in one direction. Global light-vehicle sales seen down 3.7% as Europe grows and China sinks

stories.title: Rivian says the R2 is outselling R1T, R1S and vans combined
stories.summary: Car and Driver reports Rivian saying the R2 is outselling the R1T truck, R1S SUV and delivery vans combined. The smaller Rivian is doing the volume talking. Rivian says the R2 is outselling R1T, R1S and vans combined

stories.title: Ford CEO aims for a 20% sales jump by 2032
stories.summary: The Wall Street Journal reports Ford's CEO is aiming for about a 20% sales jump by 2032. The long-range target lands while quarterly truck math still pays the bills. Ford CEO aims for a 20% sales jump by 2032

stories.title: Volkswagen posts a €5.8 billion Q3 loss on China and US tariff hits
stories.summary: ET Auto reports Volkswagen posted a €5.8 billion third-quarter loss amid weak China demand and US tariffs. The group results slide needed a wider margin than usual. Volkswagen posts a €5.8 billion Q3 loss on China and US tariff hits

stories.title: Car and Driver samples the all-electric 2027 BMW i3 twin
stories.summary: Car and Driver drives the all-electric 2027 BMW i3, calling out an uncompromising fraternal twin to the combustion story. Another BMW EV badge gets real road miles in the notebook.

stories.title: Kia posts 24% rise in third-quarter operating profit
stories.summary: UPI reports South Korea's Kia posted a 24% rise in third-quarter operating profit. The earnings print adds another strong quarter from a volume brand still balancing hybrids, EVs and exports.

stories.title: Ford sets a 5 million vehicle sales goal for 2032 after a profit beat
stories.summary: Coverage says Ford set a goal of about 5 million vehicle sales by 2032 after third-quarter profit beat estimates. The long-range volume target arrives while truck demand still pays most of the bills.
